selected_next_phase.title: Formal Project/Scenario Domain Model and Repository Boundary
selected_next_phase.short_description: Define pure domain types and a repository interface, then adapt the existing IndexedDB workspace behind it without changing RF, optimizer, or API behavior.

why_this_phase: It addresses the highest current risk: mixed ownership inside App.jsx and an opaque whole-workspace persistence record.
It preserves the working local-first behavior while creating a seam for later server persistence.
It makes scenario revisions, resolved inputs, run lineage, and report references testable before adding database operations.
It prevents a premature relational migration from copying current ambiguity into tables.
in_scope: Pure Project, Inventory, InventoryCell, DatasetRef, Scenario, ScenarioRevision, Run, ArtifactRef, ReportDefinition types
Apply OptimizationSolution as a new scenario/revision
Unit tests for round trips, stale datasets, revision lineage, and immutability
out_of_scope: Production migration of existing IndexedDB records to a new physical schema
acceptance_criteria: Existing schema v1/v2 and legacy project imports still load.
IndexedDB remains the default local persistence path with localStorage fallback.
A ScenarioRevision serializes all RF-affecting inputs needed to reconstruct current requests.
UI-only state is not serialized into a ScenarioRevision.
A Run envelope can record simulation, optimization, validation, batch experiment, and diagnostic types.
Applying an optimizer solution creates a new scenario/revision with originating_run_id.
Reports can reference explicit scenario/revision/run identities without changing the current download UI.
No production RF result, optimizer policy, dataset, or API behavior changes.
recommended_sequence: Add domain type definitions and validation helpers.
Add LocalRepository interface backed by projectStore.
Move App workspace calls to the repository adapter.
Add immutable ScenarioRevision and Run metadata tests.
Document follow-on PostgreSQL/PostGIS/object-storage adapters without implementing them.
invariance_contract: Same resolved RF request for a given existing workspace state.
Same current scenario fingerprint algorithm and output.
Same current dataset pack and active-dataset semantics.
Same optimizer search policy, budgets, Pareto public archive, and response DTOs.
